records.text: Kalecgos declares that he will no longer be Malygos’s slave and threatens challengers. Kalecgos and Sathrovarr can drive each other into a crazed rage. In thanking allies, Kalecgos says he is forever in their debt and promises the world will owe them if they triumph over Kil’jaeden.

Brutallus is a demon who mocks opponents as a “puny lizard” and “lambs to the slaughter,” boasts that their magic is weak, and invites them to challenge him. He calls killing Madrigosa fun, revealing his taunting, openly cruel manner.

Madrigosa is a dragon who calls Malygos her lord. She tries to keep Brutallus alive long enough to question him about Anveena and Kalec, then demands answers; her final words return to Malygos and say she did her best.
Lady Sacrolash is a named eredar in Sunwell Plateau. Her brief speech dwells on misery, confusion and mistrust, then calls them “the hallmarks”; she directs Shadow Nova at her foes.

Grand Warlock Alythess is a named eredar in Sunwell Plateau. Her speech names depravity, hatred and chaos, then calls them “the pillars”; she directs Conflagration at an opponent and says, “Fires consume.”
A Sunblade Cabalist is a Sunwell Plateau spellcaster that attacks with Shadow Bolt and summons an imp in combat.
A Sunblade Arch Mage among the forces in the Sunwell Plateau region, this combatant answers a fight with Frost Nova, a spell that can hinder nearby attackers.
A Sunblade Slayer encountered in the Sunwell Plateau region, this combatant uses a bow to Shoot during battle, keeping its attack at range.
A Sunblade Vindicator, a fighter among the forces in the Sunwell Plateau region who strikes brutally.
A Sunblade Dusk Priest found among the forces in the Sunwell Plateau region, this combatant can cast Fear during battle to unsettle opponents.
A Sunblade Dawn Priest among the forces in the Sunwell Plateau region, who takes on a holy form when attacked.
A Sunblade Scout in the Sunwell Plateau region who spots enemies and calls, “Enemies spotted! Attack while I try to activate a Protector!”
A Shadowsword Soulbinder of the Sunwell Plateau region, a dark caster who curses foes with exhaustion and can dominate their minds.
A Shadowsword Manafiend is found in the Sunwell Plateau region. In combat, it can drain mana and unleash Arcane Explosion.
A Shadowsword Assassin of the Sunwell Plateau region that cloaks itself in greater invisibility.
A Shadowsword Vanquisher patrols the Sunwell Plateau region and fights with Cleave. It calls for intruders to be kept out of the Sanctum, showing its role as a defender of that place.
A Shadowsword Lifeshaper of the Sunwell Plateau region that drains the life from its foes.
A Sunblade Protector in the Sunwell Plateau region, a machine-like sentinel that gives terse status reports such as “Enemy presence detected.” It uses invisibility and stealth detection.
A Shadowsword Guardian of the Sunwell Plateau region that bears down on its foes.
The Priestess of Torment, a humanoid of the Sunwell Plateau region who whirls through her foes.
Painbringer is a demon in the Sunwell Plateau.
Doomfire Destroyer is a humanoid of the Sunwell Plateau region that creates Doomfire Shards.
Apocalypse Guard is a humanoid of the Sunwell Plateau region that cleaves, strikes corruptingly and hurls Death Coil; badly hurt, it hardens its defense.
Chaos Gazer is a humanoid of the Sunwell Plateau region that drains life and can petrify.
Oblivion Mage is a humanoid of the Sunwell Plateau region that buffets its foes with flame.
A combat hound of the Sunwell Plateau that breathes cataclysm on its foes and enrages when close to defeat.

Kil'jaeden is a commander bent on completing a long-laid plan: he urges followers to drain a girl's power, demands they stay on task, and threatens eternal punishment for failure. His words convey impatience and coercive authority.

Vindicator Moorba is assigned by Captain Selana to assist the Sunwell Plateau effort. She supports the campaign with transports to Apex Point and the Witch's Sanctum, and her dialogue covers the Sunwell's Gates and routes toward Kil'jaeden.

Captain Selana oversees a grim military situation at the Sunwell Plateau and assigns Vindicator Moorba to assist the effort. Her dialogue offers a situation report, presenting her as a source of information about the campaign.
Anchorite Elbadon is a humanoid in Sunwell Plateau.
Neophyte Narama is a humanoid in Sunwell Plateau.
A Shattered Sun soldier.
M'uru is a named being of the Sunwell Plateau.
A Shadowsword commander in the Sunwell Plateau who calls, “Bring forth the imps!” and bellows battle shouts.
A volatile fiend among the Sunwell Plateau enemies that stirs up Burning Winds.
A Sunblade dragonhawk, a beast of the Sunwell Plateau area that breathes flame.
A guardian of the Sunwell found in the Sunwell Plateau.

Grand Magister Rommath treats Quel'Delar as a symbol of the sin'dorei's resolve. He compares its broken state to Silvermoon after Kael'thas's betrayal, recalls that Thalorien's sacrifice could not save the Sunwell, and directs the sword's bearer toward Dalaran, where Aethas Sunreaver or Vereesa Windrunner awaits.

Lor'themar Theron, Regent Lord of Quel'Thalas, sees Quel'Delar restored as the return of Thalorien Dawnseeker's legendary sword. He calls a hero an inspiration to the sin'dorei and a symbol of their endurance through tragedy and treachery; he also replies, “We shall see.”

Captain Auric Sunchaser speaks for the high elves. He says Quel'Delar matters to all children of Silvermoon, not only the sin'dorei, and urges the lords to rally behind its bearer in response to the destruction of Silvermoon and the Sunwell.
The Sunwell Honor Guard are guards associated with the Sunwell. Their recorded reaction to Quel'Delar is a question of startled recognition: “Can that really be Quel'Delar?”
A blood elf pilgrim found among the visitors at the Argent Tournament.
Chamberlain Galiros is a formal announcer at the Argent Tournament. He presents the bearer of Quel'Delar to the assembled lords and ladies.

place_records.text: You are in Sunwell Plateau, a plateau on the Isle of Quel'Danas that holds the Sunwell. Kalecgos, Brutallus and Kil'jaeden are its masters, and Kil'jaeden is a commander pursuing a long-laid plan. Sunblade vindicators, priests and mages fill the plateau with Shadowsword vanquishers and volatile fiends. The end of Quel'Delar's exile is said to await within, where Quel'Thalas's regent and Grand Magister Rommath stand.

You are in Parhelion Plaza on the Sunwell Plateau, where Kalecgos stands. Captain Selana, Vindicator Moorba, Anchorite Elbadon and Neophyte Narama hold a foothold here with their soldiers, while Sunblade dawn priests and vindicators press around them.

You are in the Dead Scar on the Sunwell Plateau, where the demon Brutallus stands with Shadowsword vanquishers, soulbinders, manafiends and lifeshapers. The dragon Madrigosa is here, trying to keep him alive long enough to question him about Anveena and Kalec.
